title: Phases in a class of associative memories via hidden neurons
abstract: arXiv:2609.10976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Associative memory in the Hopfield network is attractor dynamics in a disordered many-body system, and higher-order and exponential extensions turn its retrieval update into softmax attention. The polynomial and exponential regimes have been analyzed by different methods, with no common architecture in which to ask what fixes the storage scale. In this paper we study the bipartite architecture of Krotov and Hopfield, which we call the class $H$, whose model is fixed by a Lagrangian for each layer, taking the hidden neurons as the order parameter of retrieval. At polynomial load the replica method yields the replica-symmetric phase diagrams and closed-form capacities, and the crosstalk moment is common to Ising and spherical visible neurons, so their differences come from the visible entropy. translated_title: 基于隐神经元的一类联想记忆中的相
translated_abstract: Hopfield网络中的联想记忆是无序多体系统中的吸引子动力学，其高阶与指数形式扩展将检索更新转化为softmax注意力机制。多项式与指数两种负载模式此前由不同方法分别分析，缺乏一个统一架构来追问是什么决定了存储规模。本文研究了Krotov和Hopfield提出的二部图架构（我们称之为H类），其模型由每层各自的拉格朗日量确定，并将隐神经元取为检索的序参量。在多项式负载下，复制方法给出了复制对称相图和闭式容量，且串扰矩对Ising型与球面型可见神经元是共同的，因此两者的差异来自可见熵。当采用softmax隐层时，负载为指数级，一种复制表示将热力学映射到随机能量模型的计数问题上，其参……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文以Krotov-Hopfield二部架构中的隐神经元作为检索序参量，统一框架下证明了多项式负载的复制对称相图与闭式容量，并将softmax隐层下的指数级负载热力学映射为随机能量模型计数，从而阐明了决定联想记忆存储规模的共同机制。
en_tdlr: By taking hidden neurons as the retrieval order parameter in the Krotov-Hopfield bipartite architecture (class H), this paper unifies replica-symmetric phase diagrams with closed-form capacities at polynomial load and maps the exponential-load thermodynamics of softmax hidden layers onto random-energy-model counting, clarifying what fixes the storage scale of associative memories.
